page.overview:
What is Larvitar?

Larvitar is a small, olive green reptilian Pokémon with rock-hard skin. It has small, chubby arms and legs. It has a blunt spike protruding from its head. Its body is covered in a green armour with few diamond-shaped holes on it. It has a red diamond-shaped chest plate, unlike its evolutions. Its eyes have a black pupil with red iris and black markings around it. Its tail is conical in shape.

Larvitar usually feeds on soil, and even entire mountains, in order to evolve and grow into a healthy Pupitar.

Larvitar evolves into Pupitar starting at level 30 and then evolves into Tyranitar starting at level 55.

This Pokémon learns no moves by Tutoring.
